name: AMC Flip Tiles
description: Launch tiles that turn over in 3D on hover and keyboard focus: icon and label on the front, a description and a call to action on a colored back face, while each tile stays one real link.
useFor: Launchpads and module menus with 3 to 16 entries where a destination needs one or two lines of explanation, such as self-service portals and onboarding hubs.
helpText: List template for a List region. Front: the entry icon and text. Back: User Defined Attribute 1 as the description and Attribute 2 as the call-to-action text, for example 'Request leave'; when Attribute 2 is empty only an arrow is shown. Tiles turn over on hover and on keyboard focus; each tile is a single link, so Tab moves through the tiles in list order and Enter opens the destination. The current entry has a filled front. On touch screens and under reduced motion both faces are shown together as one tile, so nothing is hover-only and nothing moves. Template options: Flip vertically, Compact, Palette, Ink.

templateOptions.name: Flip vertically
templateOptions.help: Tiles turn over top to bottom instead of sideways.

templateOptions.name: Compact
templateOptions.help: Smaller tiles of 138px, for side columns and dense menus.

templateOptions.name: Palette
templateOptions.help: Each tile takes a hue derived from the theme's primary color. Browsers without relative color syntax keep the primary color.

templateOptions.name: Ink
templateOptions.help: Neo-brutal look: ink borders in the theme text color, flat fills and hard offset shadows.
